detail_rows.label: Audience overlap
detail_rows.evidence: 68% of category buyers on the platform are under 35 against 24% of our base. Only 11% overlap with our existing buyer emails — this is genuinely new demand.

detail_rows.label: Fee-structure economics
detail_rows.evidence: 8% commission beats Amazon’s 15% referral, but AOV runs $34 against our $58 site average and fulfilment stays with us. Per-unit CM lands at 21% blended.

detail_rows.label: Operational lift
detail_rows.evidence: 12–16 videos a month, a 3-day handling SLA we do not currently meet, and a separate returns flow. 46 hours a month, permanently.

detail_rows.label: Competitive intensity
detail_rows.evidence: Eleven sellers in the subcategory with no dominant player. Density in adjacent categories tripled within nine months of opening, so the window is short.

detail_rows.label: Channel conflict risk
detail_rows.evidence: Platform promotional pressure pushes against MAP, and 3.4% of projected GMV substitutes Shopify DTC — our highest-margin channel.
